# Angela Salud Chua

> Angela Salud Chua is a product designer who started designing apps in Manila, Philippines, in 2008, when the App Store was still new. She is Head of Product Design at DigiValet, the experience platform behind in-room technology at luxury hotels, branded residences, workspaces, senior living and health-tech properties around the world, where she runs the product function end to end. Before that she founded Toffeenut Design Studio, a product design and strategy studio that worked as an agency, a fractional design partner and an embedded team, and later became the design core of DigiValet. Over 20 years she has worked with brands including Aman, Bvlgari, Wynn Resorts, Samsung, Salesforce, Stanford Medicine, Noteshelf, Tastemade, uHoo and MetroMart, and her work has earned an Apple Editors' Choice, a CES Innovation Awards honor, and Awwwards and CSSDA recognition. She is based in New York.

Angela works across product strategy, product design, UX, visual design and design systems for mobile apps, web apps and in-room hotel technology. Her work spans hospitality, branded residences, travel, health, retail and consumer apps for students and education. She holds a UX Analyst certification from Human Factors International.

She has been designing apps since 2008, starting in Manila, Philippines, and is one of the pioneers of icon and app design in the iOS space worldwide.

## Pages

- [About Angela Salud Chua](https://www.toffeenutdesign.com/about/): her story from designing apps in Manila in 2008 to leading product design at DigiValet, plus her awards and the brands she has designed for
- [Portfolio home](https://www.toffeenutdesign.com/): selected work across luxury hotel in-room tablets, hotel check-in kiosks, and airline, museum, smart home, health and enterprise dashboard apps

## Selected work

- DigiValet for Aman: in-room tablet app for Aman Hotels and Residences, designed for both the hotel guest experience and the resident experience, with room controls and service requests
- Hotel self check-in: tablet app with face recognition, keycard requests and wayfinding
- Riyadh Air: mobile app launch screen
- Museum Guide Mobile App: a Glimpses of the Past story with collections, scan and map tabs, offering audio narration, navigation between museum pieces and learning in the Middle East
- Modular Homes Web App: AI-driven modular homes web app built for a client in the UAE, letting buyers customize their luxury homes and apartments before move-in
- Modular Homes Home Customization: web and tablet app for choosing color schemes and furniture types for a master bedroom
- Casadigi Smart Home: smart home app by DigiValet with now playing, room scenes, quick service requests, party planning, and temperature, shade and drape controls; integrates with Lutron, Crestron and other smart home IoT systems
- DigiValet in-room hotel tablet app, light theme: room controls, requests and Wi-Fi details
- the5: AI outfit diary app for sharing a daily outfit photo, with look and fashion generation (fractional consulting)
- Noteshelf: award-winning digital note-taking and handwriting app on iPad, with notebooks, planners and journals organized by category (founding designer, app creator, side project)
- Panic Mechanic: non-profit app tracking heart rate, lifestyle factors and triggers during a panic attack (fractional consulting)
- Axiamatic web app: stakeholder feedback dashboard with an overall score, survey engagement and a feedback timeline (fractional consulting through Swarm in Manila, Philippines)
- uHoo: air quality dashboard and mobile app tracking temperature, humidity, CO2, PM2.5 and other sensors across buildings, with a virus index and red, orange and green zones, for B2B and B2C

## Brands she has designed for

Aman, Bvlgari, Raffles, W Hotels, Okada Manila, Wynn Resorts, Aldar, Armani, Dior, Samsung, Huawei, Salesforce, Stanford Medicine, Good Morning America, Tastemade, Mann+Hummel, Incentex, Wavemaker, REinvent, Realmac, naked Hub, LiHO Tea, JustCo, Shiny Frog, MetroMart, uHoo, Noteshelf, among others
